title: Transfer to the interpreter
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $D$ be a four-work-tape machine over the Boolean alphabet with finite state set and decidable state equality, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$. If $c$ is halted, one step of the capture wrapper from the first-phase configuration associated to $c$ equals the interpreter-entry configuration associated to $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state machine over the Boolean alphabet
$D$ is a four-work-tape Boolean machine with finite state set and decidable state equality
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on the finite Boolean input $x$
replaced:
Let $c$ be a halted configuration of a machine $M$ on input $x$.  Then one
transition of the output-capture wrapper of $M$ and a four-tape interpreter
$D$, applied to the first-phase embedding of $c$, yields the
interpreter-entry configuration for $c$: every component of $c$ is preserved
and the control becomes the interpreter's initial state.
